mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 60 degrees. If you look up at 8:30 PM tonight, you will be able to see the International Space Station traveling from the northwest near Verona High School toward the east near Fitchburg, reaching halfway up the sky.

City residents should mark their calendars for a free e-waste recycling event on October 17 at the Verona Recycling Center from 8 AM to 3 PM to dispose of old electronics, and don't forget the Verona Police Department is actively hiring new patrol officers.
There is plenty to do with Hop Haus Trivia happening today, followed by the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and Wednesday Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory tomorrow.
In a noteworthy update, on September 5, an officer investigated a series of reports involving cheese slices left on car windshields across several streets in a viral social media stunt.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a facility remodel, so there is no flavor of the day to report at this time.
